images.title: A number line from 0 to 80,000
images.purpose: Show where 47,340 sits on a number line marked in steps of 20,000.
images.composition: One long horizontal number line across the frame with five labelled marks and a flag on the line at 47,340.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal line with five tall tick marks equally spaced, labelled left to right 0, 20,000, 40,000, 60,000, 80,000. Between each pair of tall ticks there is one short unlabelled tick. A flag on a pole stands on the line a little to the right of the 40,000 mark, in #CC79A7, with the label '47,340' above it. A thin #0072B2 bracket under the line joins the 40,000 mark to the flag and is labelled 'a little more than 40,000'. No other marks.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A number sits between two marks, and its leading digits tell which two.
